attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Door Block. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. Mirror: choose one option (for example: True, False). Tip: start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need. Template parent examples: L_FrontDoor_Ctrl, Spine_End_Jnt, Head_Jnt.
